beats.text: Six things genuinely confident people do differently.
One. They make a decision and move on. They don't marinate in what-ifs for weeks.
Two. They ask for what they want — directly, without three layers of apology.
Three. They're okay being disliked. They'd rather be real than universally approved of.
Four. They celebrate other people's wins without feeling one inch smaller.
Five. They speak slowly, and let silence sit. They don't rush to fill every gap.
Six. They keep the small promises they make to themselves. That's where the confidence came from.
Confidence isn't believing you're the best. It's not needing to be, to feel okay.
